# Chrono24

> > Global luxury watch marketplace providing seller tools, compliance guidance, and security resources for watch dealers and collectors.

Chrono24 is the world's leading online marketplace for luxury watches, connecting buyers and sellers globally. This documentation covers seller optimization strategies, legal compliance requirements (EPR, BATT, EEE), security best practices, and platform features like personalized offers and wishlists.

## Key Topics

- Chrono24 marketplace
- Listing optimization
- Personalized offers
- Wishlist features
- EPR legislation compliance
- BATT (Battery Act) regulations
- EEE (Electrical and Electronic Equipment) compliance
- Phishing protection
- Seller tools and features
- Legal requirements for sellers
- Battery compliance
- Electronic equipment regulations
- Credit card fraud prevention
- Sales visibility optimization

## Seller Tools & Optimization

- [Listing Optimization](https://update.chrono24.com/listing-optimization/): Guide for sellers to optimize listings and increase sales visibility

## Security & Fraud Prevention

- [Phishing Protection](https://update.chrono24.com/phishing/): Security guide on phishing risks and credit card fraud protection
